Meta.title: NEEDIT
Meta.description: Find what you need from nearby stores and get it delivered.

Common.notFoundBody: The link may be old, or the item is no longer listed.

freshness.stale: Availability may be out of date

Home.headline: What do you need?
Home.locationHelp: This sets the address area for checkout. Stock on this prototype is for central Riyadh.

Search.title: Search
Search.emptyHint: Try a product name, like a cable, notebook, or balloons.
Search.needPhrase: These are product matches from nearby stores. A suggested basket for a whole need is not part of this prototype.
Search.sorted: Best matches first, then faster nearby options.

Product.otherStoreTitle: Your cart is from another store
Product.otherStoreBody: One order is one store. Replace {store} with this item?
Product.closedNote: This store is closed. You can look, but checkout waits until it opens.
Product.unavailable: This item is out of stock.

Store.title: Store
Store.empty: This store has no listed products.
Store.closedNote: Closed right now. Products stay visible so you can see what they carry.

Cart.title: Cart
Cart.closed: This store is closed, so checkout is paused.

Checkout.title: Checkout
Checkout.instructionsHint: Optional. Gate code, floor, or where to leave the bag.
Checkout.codHelp: Pay the courier when the order arrives. Simulated in this prototype.
Checkout.demoNote: Demo only. No card is charged, and the full number is not stored.

errors.expiry: Enter a future expiry as MM/YY.
errors.closed: The store is closed, so this order cannot be placed.
errors.unavailable: An item in the cart is no longer available.
errors.mixed: The cart has items from more than one store.

Order.title: Order
Order.tooLate: This order can no longer be cancelled.
Order.simulated: Delivery status is simulated in this prototype.
Order.notFound: That order is not on this device.

detail.COURIER_ASSIGNED: A courier is heading to the store.
detail.OUT_FOR_DELIVERY: It is on the way to you.

Support.title: Help
Support.intro: Tell us what went wrong with an order. This stays on your device in the prototype.
Support.sent: Request {id} is saved on this device.

errors.message: Describe the issue in a few words.

delivery.a: Each store shows its own estimate. This prototype simulates the courier instead of dispatching one.

area.a: The pilot is central Riyadh. One order comes from one store.

payment.a: Cash on delivery, or a demo card. No real charge is made.

cancel.a: You can cancel while the order is placed or just accepted. After preparation starts, this prototype will not cancel it.

Account.title: Account
Account.guestBody: Accounts and sign-in come with the live marketplace. This prototype keeps your cart and orders on this device.
